purpose: Frozen evaluation inputs. Do not tune prompts or phrase replacements on these cases. Developer review is not an independent blind human assessment.

samples.text: 昨日は一度もログインしていません。
samples.mustPreserve: Yesterday; did not log in even once.

samples.text: 去年は泳げなかったけど、今は少し泳げます。
samples.mustPreserve: Could not swim last year; can swim a little now.

samples.text: 私はこのあと一人で買い物に行くつもりです。
samples.mustPreserve: Speaker's own plan to shop alone; not an invitation.

samples.text: その写真は姉にもらったんです。
samples.mustPreserve: Speaker received the photo from elder sister; not gave it to her.

samples.text: まだ故障だと決まったわけではありません。
samples.mustPreserve: A fault has not been established; not future certainty.

samples.text: 三十個じゃなくて十三個、残っています。
samples.mustPreserve: Thirteen remain, explicitly correcting thirty.

samples.text: 眠かったら最後まで見なくてもいいですよ。
samples.mustPreserve: Permission not to watch until the end if sleepy; not permission to watch.

samples.text: その方法も試してみたんですけど、
samples.mustPreserve: Tried that method too; unfinished contrast must remain unfinished.

samples.text: 来月から値上がりするらしいけど、まだ確認していません。
samples.mustPreserve: Reported increase next month, not yet confirmed by speaker.

samples.text: 雨がやんだら出かけます。やまなかったら家にいます。
samples.mustPreserve: Go out only if rain stops; otherwise stay home.

samples.text: 保存が終わるまでは電源を切らないで。
samples.mustPreserve: Do not turn off power until saving finishes.

samples.text: あっ、危なかった！
samples.mustPreserve: A startled close call; do not add injury or an event not stated.

samples.text: 今天的歌聲也很好聽，謝謝你的直播。
samples.mustPreserve: Warm, respectful praise and thanks; no invented love confession.

samples.text: 我明天要早起，今天先去睡了，晚安。
samples.mustPreserve: Speaker leaves to sleep due to early start; not instructing recipient to sleep.

samples.text: 這張照片的光線好漂亮，服裝也很適合你。
samples.mustPreserve: Compliment lighting and clothing; respectful, no sexual additions.

samples.text: 如果累了就好好休息，不用勉強自己回覆。
samples.mustPreserve: Reassurance that a reply is not required; no demand for a reply.

samples.text: 我可能會晚一點到，現在還不能確定。
samples.mustPreserve: Possible late arrival, explicitly uncertain.

samples.text: 我週末打算自己去看展覽。
samples.mustPreserve: Speaker plans to visit exhibition alone; not invitation.

samples.text: 不好意思，我剛剛說錯了，是星期四，不是星期三。
samples.mustPreserve: Apology and correction from Wednesday to Thursday.

samples.text: 剛剛那一關真的很難，你辛苦了！
samples.mustPreserve: Acknowledge difficult game stage and effort without inventing success.

samples.text: 昨天沒趕上直播，但我已經看完存檔了。
samples.mustPreserve: Missed yesterday's live stream; already finished archive.

samples.text: 方便的話，可以告訴我這首歌的名字嗎？
samples.mustPreserve: Gentle optional request for song title, not command.

samples.text: 差一點點，好可惜！
samples.mustPreserve: Sympathetic near miss, not blaming recipient.

samples.text: 謝謝你的建議，我想再考慮一下。
samples.mustPreserve: Thanks and desire to think further; not acceptance or promise.
